name: Boston Dynamics Spot
price_basis: assumed low-cost equivalent of the listed part: 5 x sqrt(list price), to the nearest $5 (see catalog/README.md, Prices)
src: 14 kg payload and $75,000 from comparison sites; 30 cm step unverified
notes: MuJoCo Menagerie simulator model (no open CAD). Outline, mass, standing height, the support rectangle (the feet) and the mounts ('top' on the trunk, 'front' front_inset_m behind the trunk's nose) are read from the model in its 'home' keyframe when the composer loads the card. Treated as holonomic (assumed): a quadruped can sidestep and turn in place, so it need not swing its length through a turn.
